title: Case D: FLAC3D excavation pit
description: Circular deep pit (about 32 m wide, floor at z = -57.5 m) in a 150 m x 150 m x 111 m domain. The excavated zones were deleted before export, so the model contains no void cells; the pit walls and floor are found as the boundary of the retained solid that does not lie on the box faces of the domain.
